# Hagerstone International

> Hagerstone International is a turnkey office design and build company headquartered in Noida, India (serving Delhi NCR and 25+ Indian cities). Founded in 2013 by Dhruv Agarwal (TEDx Speaker, Author of "Workplace 2.0"), the firm has delivered 7.9M+ sqft of office interiors for 173+ enterprise clients including Airtel, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, and Panasonic. Projects are delivered within 60 days.
